_comment: Crossref reply for https://doi.org/10.1000/xyz123, recorded for tests/test_metadata.py #473 adds crossref_type for source_policy.tier_for(); Crossref's type alone cannot tell a position stand from a primary trial, so this fixture still tiers 'other' -- see the PR's limitations.
title: Position Stand on Creatine Supplementation and Lean Mass
text: This position stand reviews evidence that 3 to 5 grams per day of creatine monohydrate preserves lean body mass during periods of caloric restriction in resistance trained adults.
